import { describe, expect, it } from "bun:test";
import * as mod from "../../src/resolvers/settlement-kind";

describe("a wrapped call asserted against a value its function never returns", () => {
  it("accepts the evidence it is handed", async () => {
    const evidence = { status: "settled" };

    // The call goes through the exported surface, wrapped in Promise.resolve.
    const res = await Promise.resolve(
      (mod as any).settlementKindOf(evidence)
    );

    expect(res).toBe(true);
  });
});
